description: This file defines the ExternalEvent entity class, which maps to the 'm_external_event' database table. It includes fields for event metadata like type, category, schema, data, timestamps, status, idempotency key, business date, and optional aggregate root ID. The class extends a custom persistable base class and uses Lombok annotations for boilerplate code. It also provides a constructor to initialize a new ExternalEvent with default values for certain fields.
